info.title: App Store Public Reads
info.summary: Read-only, normalized public-data reads of App Store applications exposed through the ReplyNodes App Store public-read service: app lookup, developer catalog lookup, storefront chart listings, privacy label lookup, ratings summaries, paged reviews, bounded term search, related-app listings, and type-ahead suggestions.
info.description:
Machine-readable specification for the supported public App Store read capabilities of the ReplyNodes App Store public-read service.

Surface status:
- The nine documented read operations have stable public contracts with bounded requests and normalized v1 responses.
- Route paths in this catalog are stable capability identifiers used for agent tool bindings; public gateway exposure for this platform is issued to your workspace at onboarding and must not be assumed reachable anywhere else.
- No availability, uptime, latency, or success-rate figure is claimed anywhere in this package; example payloads are illustrative fixtures, not captured responses.

Read-only guarantees:
- Every cataloged operation is an HTTP GET capability over public application data only.
- No purchase, review-submission, account, login, or any other write or authenticated capability exists in this domain, now or later; it is excluded by policy rather than by configuration.
- Only the documented operations are supported by this public package.
- No request path carries or accepts credentials, keys, or login material of any kind; the read layer performs public reads server-side.
- Only public platform data is returned; counters, scores, and prices are null when the source omits them - zeros are never fabricated - and unknown upstream fields are dropped.

Published from this public, sanitized skill-only provenance repository.

servers.description: The supported public gateway base URL is https://api.replynodes.com. Use this deployment base unless your workspace is explicitly issued another HTTPS gateway URL; never use localhost:18789.

get.summary: Look up one public App Store application
get.description: Returns exactly one normalized public application record referenced by numeric track id or bundle id, per contract v1 (developer, rating, pricing, genres, languages, version, release data). An unknown or non-public id yields not_found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric track id (up to 19 digits) or reverse-DNS-style bundle id; provide id or appId.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: Alias for id; provide appId or id.

get.summary: Search public App Store applications by term
get.description: Returns zero or more normalized public application records matching a free-text term, as one bounded page (default 20 results, clamped to at most 50). No continuation tokens exist on this surface.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Free-text search query; required and never empty after trimming.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size bound; defaults to 20 and is clamped to at most 50 client-side.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional storefront hint, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (e.g. us).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).

get.summary: List public apps related to one App Store application
get.description: Returns zero or more normalized public application records related to the app referenced by numeric track id or bundle id, as one bounded page (default 20 results, clamped to at most 50). No continuation tokens exist on this surface.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric track id (up to 19 digits) or reverse-DNS-style bundle id; provide id or appId.

get.summary: List public App Store applications by storefront
get.description: Returns zero or more normalized public application records for a given storefront category and country, as one bounded page (default 20 results, clamped to at most 50). No continuation tokens exist on this surface.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. us).

get.description: Returns zero or more normalized type-ahead suggestions for public App Store applications based on a partial term, as one bounded page (default 20 results, clamped to at most 50). No continuation tokens exist on this surface.

bearerAuth.description: The gateway supports two honest access paths: a ReplyNodes workspace key in Authorization: Bearer <workspace-key>, or x402 v2 payment negotiation when the route returns HTTP 402. Scope/entitlement checks belong to the shared control plane; this package does not claim payment settlement or a successful paid request. ReplyNodes API keys are minted per workspace from the ReplyNodes console and are stored server-side only as SHA-256 hashes; treat them as sensitive material and never embed them in client-side code.

x402.description: x402 v2 payment negotiation in USDC on Base

App.description: Normalized public App Store application record (contract v1). Optional values stay null when the public source omitted them; zeros are never fabricated; unknown upstream fields are dropped at parse time.

bundle_id.description: Reverse-DNS bundle id, or null when omitted.

url.description: Public store page URL, or null when omitted.

released_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, or null when omitted.

updated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, or null when omitted.

ResponseMeta.description: Provenance metadata echoed with every response. request_id echoes the caller-supplied opaque correlation id; missing_fields appears only when availability is partial, using dotted *. paths that apply to every element of data.

detail.description: Fixed generic note; never provider diagnostics.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Body of every non-2xx response on this surface; retry hints travel in the Retry-After header.
